author: MIT OpenCourseWare
description: Half a billion people worldwide have used MIT OpenCourseWare to transform their lives. From a student in Uganda gaining access to world-class education, to Ukrainian learners finding community during wartime, to community college instructors inspiring their students—this is the real story of how one institution's bold decision to share learning materials for free has created a ripple effect across 190+ countries. Hear directly from the learners and educators whose lives have been changed by OpenCourseWare.
title: From Uganda to Ukraine: The Global Impact of MIT OpenCourseWare at 25
